brief:
Hamas condemned Israeli military strikes targeting civilians in northern and southern Gaza on Wednesday, Shehab Wire reported. The strikes killed at least one person and wounded several others, according to the movement's statement issued in response to the attacks.

The Palestinian resistance faction characterized the Israeli operations as deliberate attempts to undermine ongoing ceasefire negotiations. Hamas said the targeting of civilians demonstrated the occupation's determination to obstruct a potential truce agreement. The statement did not provide specifics on the exact locations, timing, or scale of the strikes beyond identifying them as occurring across Gaza's northern and southern regions.
